title: Deepak Kumar v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Anjani Kumar Mishra, J. and Chandra Kumar Rai, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; Executive Engineer directed to decide the pending Clause 6.5 representation by a reasoned order within three weeks.
headnote: A Division Bench disposed of a tube-well restoration writ without granting reconnection on merits, directing the Executive Engineer to consider and dispose of the petitioner's pending representation under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 by a reasoned and speaking order within three weeks of a copy of the order being filed.
facts: The dispute concerned a personal tube-well electricity connection standing in the petitioner's grandfather's name. An earlier writ by the petitioner's uncle (Writ-C No. 37324 of 2019) had been dismissed with the observation that bill correction must be sought from the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Alleging that a subsequent representation remained undecided, the petitioner sought mandamus to restore the connection and to have the Clause 6.5 representation decided.

holding_units.holding: Where a consumer has already made a representation to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 for bill correction, following an earlier writ that relegated bill correction to that forum, the High Court will not restore a disconnected tube-well connection on merits and will instead dispose of the writ by directing the Executive Engineer to consider and dispose of that representation by a reasoned and speaking order within a fixed time.

principle_tags.application: The Court did not decide restoration or the bill; it remitted the pending Clause 6.5 representation to the Executive Engineer for a reasoned order within three weeks.
Mandamus to restore the tube-well connection was refused on merits; Clause 6.5 before the Executive Engineer remained the remedy for the billing dispute.

not_decided.point: Whether the tube-well electricity connection should be restored
not_decided.note: The prayer for mandamus to restore supply was not granted on merits; the Court only directed disposal of the pending Clause 6.5 representation.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the electricity bill and the merits of the Clause 6.5 representation
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer to decide by a reasoned and speaking order.
